title: I built a QR code with my bare hands to see how it works
summary: Veritasium builds a QR code by hand to explain how it works. It covers the history of Morse code and barcodes, how QR codes encode data, why damaged codes still scan, and how safe they are.
why: HN points to it as a recent, well-made explanation of QR code structure and error correction.

quote.text: Derek Muller just did an interesting take on QR codes and their history
